commands:
BASE=$(.prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/config-get.sh .base_branch main) || BASE=""
[ -n "$BASE" ] || BASE=main
CUR=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null) || CUR=""
COMMON_DIR=$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null) || COMMON_DIR=""
GIT_DIR_PATH=$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-dir 2>/dev/null) || GIT_DIR_PATH=""
echo "BASE=$BASE CUR=$CUR COMMON_DIR=$COMMON_DIR GIT_DIR_PATH=$GIT_DIR_PATH"

python3 lib/test/lint-brand-devflow-sweep.py --print-population 2>/dev/null | sort > .prflow/tmp/population.txt; echo "=== pending (renameable) lines, by file ==="; grep -c '^pending' .prflow/tmp/population.txt; echo "=== frozen-provenance lines ==="; grep -c '^frozen-provenance' .prflow/tmp/population.txt; echo "=== other frozen ==="; grep -cE '^frozen-(record|historical|tooling|transient)' .prflow/tmp/population.txt; echo "=== ALL pending files with counts ==="; grep '^pending' .prflow/tmp/pop …[per-command-truncated]

.prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/workpad.py update 2003 --status Implementing --note "§2.2.7 coupled-site map (grep 'lint-brand-devflow|brand-devflow' over lib/test, scripts): lib/test/brand-devflow-buckets.json (data+schema) <-> lib/test/lint-brand-devflow-sweep.py (reader/validator) <-> lib/test/run.sh #1745 block (tests) <-> lib/test/modules/parallel-suite-runner.sh (builds fixture buckets + runs lint preflight). New frozen.occurrences key is OPTIONAL/back-compatible so existing fixtures without …[per-command-truncated]

for f in docs/internal/index.md docs/internal/implement-skill.md docs/internal/claude-md-extension-audit-coupled-sites.md docs/internal/cutovers/issue-614-create-issue-thin-root-relocate.md docs/internal/glossary.md; do echo "=== $f ==="; grep -n 'DevFlow' "$f"; done

echo "=== ruff config ==="; cat ruff.toml pyproject.toml .ruff.toml 2>/dev/null | head -40; echo "=== CI pinned ruff ==="; grep -rn 'ruff==' .github/workflows/ci.yml; echo "=== does base main also error locally? (spot-check origin/main version of test_python_scripts.py) ==="; git show origin/main:lib/test/test_python_scripts.py > .prflow/tmp/base_tps.py 2>/dev/null && ruff check .prflow/tmp/base_tps.py 2>&1 | tail -2

git ls-files '*.py' | xargs python3 -m ruff check --no-force-exclude 2>&1 | tail -5; echo "RUFF016_EXIT=$?"; echo "=== lint-bin ruff version ==="; /home/runner/work/_temp/prflow-lint-bin/ruff --version

ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)
mkdir -p "$ROOT/.prflow/tmp"
[ -n "${ZSH_VERSION:-}" ] && setopt nonomatch || :
set -- "$ROOT"/.prflow/tmp/review/*/*/iter-*.json
if [ -e "$1" ]; then printf '%s\n' "$@" | sort; else echo "(no pre-existing iter-*.json)"; fi

for f in docs/external/docs/getting-started/updates.md docs/external/docs/getting-started/index.md docs/internal/index.md docs/internal/implement-skill.md docs/internal/glossary.md docs/internal/cutovers/issue-614-create-issue-thin-root-relocate.md; do echo "== $f =="; grep -n "DevFlow" "$f"; python3 lib/test/lint-brand-devflow-sweep.py --print-population 2>&1 | grep "$f"; done

for f in docs/external/docs/getting-started/index.md docs/external/docs/getting-started/updates.md docs/internal/claude-md-relocated-rationale.md docs/internal/cutovers/issue-614-create-issue-thin-root-relocate.md docs/internal/glossary.md docs/internal/implement-skill.md docs/internal/index.md; do echo "=== $f ==="; grep -n "DevFlow" "$f"; done

CREATE_STATE=""
gh issue create \
  --title "Finish brand DevFlow-to-PRFlow prose sweep (Batch 5+)" \
  --body-file .prflow/tmp/deferral-draft-2003-1.md \
  && CREATE_STATE=ok || CREATE_STATE=failed
echo "phase 4.0 create fence ran; create=[${CREATE_STATE}]"

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
